label: WhatsApp payload — Bromo, Ijen Tour — Bali Origin
mandatory_notes: Bromo mornings are cold: expect 5-15°C at the crater viewpoint, so pack warm layers.
Ijen crater area runs 10-15°C overnight and pre-dawn; dress in warm, windproof layers.
Gas masks for the Ijen sulfur fumes are provided by JVTO and sterilized between uses.
Health screening is mandatory at the Banyuwangi hotel before every Ijen trek.
Blue fire is a natural, weather-dependent phenomenon at Ijen and cannot be guaranteed on any given night.
current_advisories: The Ijen crater floor (close approach to the blue fire site and lake shore) is currently closed; viewing is from the crater rim only.
wa_message_en:
